passage.label: say when promise if truthful; say knowledge only Allah I only clear warner; see approaching faces disbelieve distressed said this that used call; say Muhammad considered whether Allah cause death those with me mercy upon us who protect disbelievers painful punishment; say He Most Merciful believed Him upon Him relied you will know who clear error; say considered if water become sunken who bring flowing water

arabicExcerpts.text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
قُلۡ إِنَّمَا ٱلۡعِلۡمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةٗ سِيٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَهۡلَكَنِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوۡ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرٗا فَمَن يَأۡتِيكُم بِمَآءٖ مَّعِينِۭ

mainSubject.label: Their demand for the promise's timing answered by declaring knowledge belongs only to Allah while he is merely a clear warner; when they see it approaching their faces distress and they are told this is what they used to invoke; the rhetorical challenge whether anyone can protect disbelievers from painful punishment if Allah causes the Prophet's death or shows mercy; declaration of belief in and reliance upon the Most Merciful with the prediction that they will know who is in clear error; the closing challenge that if their water sinks into the earth, none can restore flowing water

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Say: He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him and upon Him we have relied.

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the Subtle-Acquainted argument (14) before the earth-provision-security block opens (15); P2 ends with the multiplication-and-gathering statement (24) before the eschatological-challenge block begins (25); P3 covers the timing question, the approach-distress, the protection challenge, the reliance declaration and the water challenge (25-30).
